# ui::ChoiceBinding

Header: `winui/core/Property.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::Binding< std::optional< std::size_t > >`.

What [bind_choice()](namespace-ui.md#bind_choice) returns: a two-way binding of an index onto a property holding one of a list of values. It goes into any index field, one that can show no selection (a [ListView](../controls/list-view.md#uilistview)'s `selected_index`) and one that always shows one (a [Sections](../controls/sections.md#uisections) control's). Nothing names it; see [bind_choice()](namespace-ui.md#bind_choice).
